title: Finish and evaluate the NSW employment zones reform
action: Complete the rationalisation of employment zones and evaluate how it has changed where businesses can set up, including alternative ways to manage industrial land and urban services.
why: Broader zones let new businesses set up without rezoning; an evaluation would show whether the gains are being realised and guide other states copying the reform.

evidence.source: NSW Productivity Commission White Paper 2021: Rebooting the economy
evidence.quote: Progress reforms to rationalise employment zones and evaluate alternative ways to manage industrial land and urban services.
